description: This file defines the 'Xf' class responsible for generating Excel BIFF XF records, which represent cell and style formatting in XLS spreadsheets within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles attributes like font, color, borders, protections, and text alignment, mainly used for internal spreadsheet styling.

classes.name: Xf
classes.description: Represents an XF (eXtended Format) style or cell record in an Excel XLS spreadsheet, handling style attributes such as font, colors, borders, protection, and alignment, with functionality to generate the compiled record for BIFF files.

methods.name: writeXf
methods.description: Generates an Excel BIFF XF record encoding cell or style formatting based on the object's current properties.

methods.name: setIsStyleXf
methods.description: Sets whether this XF is a style XF or a cell XF.

methods.name: setBottomColor
methods.description: Sets the border color index for the cell's bottom border.

methods.name: setTopColor
methods.description: Sets the border color index for the cell's top border.

methods.name: setLeftColor
methods.description: Sets the border color index for the cell's left border.

methods.name: setRightColor
methods.description: Sets the border color index for the cell's right border.

methods.name: setDiagColor
methods.description: Sets the border color index for diagonal borders.

methods.name: setFgColor
methods.description: Sets the foreground color index for cell patterns.

methods.name: setBgColor
methods.description: Sets the background color index for cell patterns.

methods.name: setNumberFormatIndex
methods.description: Sets the index to the number format record for this cell.

methods.name: setFontIndex
methods.description: Sets the font index for this XF.

methods.name: mapTextRotation
methods.description: Maps text rotation angles to BIFF8 codes, handling negative and special case values.

methods.name: mapLocked
methods.description: Maps cell protection 'locked' status to BIFF representation.

methods.name: mapHidden
methods.description: Maps cell protection 'hidden' status to BIFF representation.
